$comment: Texts and pushes (README.md, texts.json), plus the reply pools for texts that ask for an answer. 'line' is the phone number a text goes out on: main, or students for the student ministry. 'hour' is the local hour of the send. A push has a title and no line.

texts.text: Rock Solid: Easter is tomorrow! Services at {campus} are at {serviceTimes}. Come early for coffee and bring a friend.

texts.title: He is risen!
texts.text: Happy Easter! We saved you a seat at {serviceTimes}, or watch live in the app.
Rock Solid: Christmas Eve is tomorrow, {eventDate}. Candles, carols, and a seat for your whole family. Arrive early for parking.

texts.title: Merry Christmas Eve
texts.text: Christmas Eve services start this afternoon. Find a time near you in the app.

texts.title: Happy Thanksgiving
texts.text: We're thankful for you today. Enjoy your family and your table.

texts.title: We're live
texts.text: Church is starting now. Tap to watch the service live, wherever you are.

texts.title: New series today

texts.title: Sermon notes are in the app
texts.text: Missed Sunday or want to look back? Notes and video from {series} are in the Watch tab.
Rock Solid: Baptism Sunday is {eventDate}! Come cheer for friends and family as they go public with their faith.
Rock Solid: tomorrow is Commitment Sunday for Built on the Rock. Bring your card, or bring your questions. See you at {serviceTimes}.

texts.title: Last day to give for {eventYear}
texts.text: Gifts made in the app before midnight count toward this year. Thank you!

texts.title: Your giving statement

texts.title: Groups start this week

Hi leaders! Groups launch {eventDate}. Is your group ready to take new members? Reply YES and we'll send people your way.

texts.title: It's Serve Sunday
texts.text: Every team has a table in the lobby today. Stop by and find your spot.

Mission trip team: we leave {eventDate}! Double-check your packing list and bring your ID. We're praying for you.
Students! Wednesday night is ON tonight. Worship, games, and pizza. Bring a friend!
Men's Thanksgiving breakfast is this Saturday at Rock Solid {campus}. Reply YES if you're coming so we cook enough eggs.
Rock Solid Women: Bible study in Ruth starts this week. Morning and evening groups are open, and childcare is free in the morning.
VBS starts tomorrow at Rock Solid {campus}! Send your kids with sunscreen, a water bottle, and their loudest singing voice.

Hi {{ Person.NickName }}, you're scheduled to serve at Rock Solid {campus} on {eventDate}. Reply YES to confirm or NO if you can't make it.

Rock Solid: Hi {{ Person.NickName }}, baptism Sunday is four weeks away. Thinking about it? Fill out the short form on our website and a pastor will reach out.

Rock Solid Students: {{ Person.NickName }}! Camp spots are filling up. Want us to send your parents the sign-up link? Reply YES.
